message: Running command: cd /workspace/_work/src && git show 90d06e589 -- snmplib/snmp_enum.c 2>/dev/null | head -60

message.content:
This is the fix for the named enumeration branch (line 153). The fix adds `*cp2 &&` to the while loop condition. This confirms my analysis: when `e_enum` doesn't contain a ':', the `while (*(cp2++) != ':')` reads past the buffer.

Let me also check the "another" fix commit `90d06e589` for the numeric branch.
